newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian parliament backs new government.
newsitem.headline: Latvian parliament backs new government.

text.p: Latvia's parliament on Thursday backed the new government of Prime Minister Andris Shkele in office, politicians said.
The vote was 70 in favour of the government and 17 against in the 100-seat parliament.
The need for a new government was forced by the shock resignation of Shkele in January amid a row with President Guntis Ulmanis over a finance minister.
Ulmanis and Shkele later settled their differences and the president recalled Shkele as prime minister two weeks ago.
The new government differs little from Shkele's former administration, which came to power in December 1995.
Shkele, a non-party businessman, has helped to speed privatisation and pursue the economic reforms which Latvia launched after quitting the former Soviet Union in 1991.
